name: Kuranushi Rin
source:
"It's really annoying, but..."

Contrary to his appearance, he has a sharp tongue and shows no mercy towards girls. He gets angry when people call him cute. He also has a manly decisive side. He likes spicy food
and eats everything with shichimi.

He feels annoyed when his roommate, Yuu, treats him like a child. He enjoys teasing the serious Sakuya and talkative Mika.

Sign: Aquarius
Likes: Spicy food, horror movies
Dislikes: Crowded vehicles 
Power: Summoning

[Translated from [url=http://dearmagi.caerux.com/character]official website[/url]]
